{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgLL55WbngCqzsKTP7vep","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BFPdnXmsgKrEP6Cxg9EJeq","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"mkdir -p /root/work && cat > /root/work/ising.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np, scipy.linalg as sl, itertools\n# dimer graph construction\ndef build(W,H):\n    N=W*H; vid=lambda x,y:(x%W)+W*(y%H)\n    pos={0:(3,2),1:(2,3),2:(1.5,1.5),3:(-3,-2),4:(-2,-3),5:(-1.5,-1.5)}\n    # edge: (i,j, disp(j-i), param, seamx, seamy); param: edge index or -1 (weight 1)\n    # param edges: index e=2*v + (0 for E, 1 for N)\n    edges=[]\n    for y in range(H):\n        for x in range(W):\n            v=vid(x,y); b=6*v\n            def P(k): return np.array(pos[k],float)\n            eE=2*v; vS=vid(x,y-1); eS=2*vS+1\n            tri=[(0,1,eE),(0,2,eE),(1,2,-1),(4,3,eS),(4,5,eS),(3,5,-1)]\n            for a,c,p in tri: edges.append((b+a,b+c,P(c)-P(a),p,0,0))\n            edges.append((b+2,b+5,P(5)-P(2),-1,0,0))\n            u=6*vid(x+1,y)+3; edges.append((b+0,u,np.array([10,0.])+P(3)-P(0),-2-eE,int(x==W-1),0))\n            u=6*vid(x,y+1)+4; edges.append((b+1,u,np.array([0,10.])+P(4)-P(1),-2-(2*v+1),0,int(y==H-1)))\n    return 6*N,edges\ndef faces(n,edges):\n    nb=[[] for _ in range(n)]\n    for k,(i,j,d,*_) in enumerate(edges):\n        nb[i].append((np.arctan2(d[1],d[0]),j,k,+1)); nb[j].append((np.arctan2(-d[1],-d[0]),i,k,-1))\n    for l in nb: l.sort()\n    # half-edge (i, idx in nb[i])\n    seen=set(); F=[]\n    for i in range(n):\n        for a in range(len(nb[i])):\n            if (i,a) in seen: continue\n            f=[]; ci,ca=i,a\n            while (ci,ca) not in seen:\n                seen.add((ci,ca)); _,j,k,s=nb[ci][ca]; f.append((k,s))\n                # at j, find back edge, take next clockwise (previous in ccw-sorted)\n                bi=[q for q,t in enumerate(nb[j]) if t[2]==k and t[1]==ci][0]\n                ci,ca=j,(bi-1)%len(nb[j])\n            F.append(f)\n    return F\ndef kasteleyn(n,edges,parity):\n    F=faces(n,edges); m=len(edges)\n    M=np.zeros((len(F),m+1),np.uint8)\n    for r,f in enumerate(F):\n        c=0\n        for k,s in f:\n            M[r,k]^=1\n            if s<0: c^=1   # traversed against canonical: agree iff o_k=1... \n        # #agree = sum over s>0 of (1-o) + s<0 of o ; want ==parity(len)\n        nplus=sum(1 for k,s in f if s>0)\n        # #agree = nplus + sum o_k (mod2)\n        M[r,m]=(parity(len(f))-nplus)%2\n    # GF2 solve\n    M=M.copy(); r=0; piv=[]\n    for c in range(m):\n        p=np.nonzero(M[r:,c])[0]\n        if len(p)==0: continue\n        p=p[0]+r; M[[r,p]]=M[[p,r]]\n        rows=np.nonzero(M[:,c])[0]; rows=rows[rows!=r]\n        M[rows]^=M[r]; piv.append(c); r+=1\n        if r==M.shape[0]: break\n    assert not np.any(M[r:,m]), \"inconsistent\"\n    o=np.zeros(m,np.uint8)\n    for q,c in enumerate(piv): o[c]=M[q,m]\n    return o  # o=1 means flip: orient j->i\nclass Model:\n    def __init__(s,W,H,parity=lambda L:(L-1)%2):\n        s.W,s.H=W,H; s.n,s.edges=build(W,H); o=kasteleyn(s.n,s.edges,parity)\n        I=[];J=[];P=[];SG=[];SX=[];SY=[]\n        for k,(i,j,d,p,sx,sy) in enumerate(s.edges):\n            I.append(i);J.append(j);P.append(p);SG.append(-1. if o[k] else 1.);SX.append(sx);SY.append(sy)\n        s.I,s.J,s.P,s.SG,s.SX,s.SY=map(np.array,(I,J,P,SG,SX,SY))\n        s.tri=s.P>=0; s.ext=s.P<=-2; s.ne=2*W*H\n    def pf_terms(s,w):\n        \"\"\"w: weights per lattice edge (tanh). Return list of 4 matrices\"\"\"\n        val=np.ones(len(s.P)); val[s.tri]=w[s.P[s.tri]]\n        out=[]\n        for ex,ey in itertools.product((0,1),(0,1)):\n            sg=s.SG*np.where((s.SX&ex)|(s.SY&ey),-1.,1.)\n            A=np.zeros((s.n,s.n)); A[s.I,s.J]=sg*val; A[s.J,s.I]=-sg*val\n            out.append((A,sg))\n        return out\ndef pfaffian_schur(A):\n    T,Z=sl.schur(A,output='real'); n=len(A)\n    b=T[np.arange(0,n,2),np.arange(1,n,2)]\n    sgn,ld=np.linalg.slogdet(Z)\n    return sgn*np.prod(np.sign(b)), np.sum(np.log(np.abs(b)))\nEOF\ncat > /root/work/test.py <<'EOF'\nimport sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/root/work')\nfrom ising import *\nW,H=4,3\nrng=np.random.default_rng(0)\nfor par in [lambda L:(L-1)%2, lambda L:1, lambda L:0, lambda L:L%2]:\n  try: m=Model(W,H,par)\n  except AssertionError as e: print('inc');continue\n  K=rng.uniform(-0.35,0.9,2*W*H); w=np.tanh(K)\n  # brute S = sum over even subgraphs prod t\n  N=W*H; S=0\n  for c in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=2*N):\n    deg=np.zeros(N,int)\n    for e,u in enumerate(c):\n      if u:\n        v=e//2; x,y=v%W,v//W; u2=((x+1)%W+W*y) if e%2==0 else (x+W*((y+1)%H))\n        deg[v]+=1;deg[u2]+=1\n    if np.all(deg%2==0): S+=np.prod(w[np.array(c)==1])\n  pf=[ (lambda r:r[0]*np.exp(r[1]))(pfaffian_schur(A)) for A,_ in m.pf_terms(w)]\n  print(S,pf)\nEOF\npython /root/work/test.py"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1381,"cache_read_input_tokens":25883,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1381},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"08b490ed-295a-48e1-96f2-31d974f30297","uuid":"2265e059-f89b-4687-8eda-72489290f931","timestamp":"2026-10-24T03:11:47.125Z","request_id":"req_011CgLL55EEom4QuB6AG7iVp"}

M[[r,p]]=M[[p,r]]\n        rows=np.nonzero(M[:,c])[0]; rows=rows[rows!=r]\n        M[rows]^=M[r]; piv.append(c); r+=1\n        if r==M.shape[0]: break\n    assert not np.any(M[r:,m]), \"inconsistent\"\n    o=np.zeros(m,np.uint8)\n    for q,c in enumerate(piv): o[c]=M[q,m]\n    return o  # o=1 means flip: orient j->i\nclass Model:\n    def __init__(s,W,H,parity=lambda L:(L-1)%2):\n        s.W,s.H=W,H; s.n,s.edges=build(W,H); o=kasteleyn(s.n,s.edges,parity)\n        I=[];J=[];P=[];SG=[];SX=[];SY=[]\n        for k,(i,j,d,p,sx,sy) in enumerate(s.edges):\n            I.append(i);J.append(j);P.append(p);SG.append(-1. if o[k] else 1.);SX.append(sx);SY.append(sy)\n        s.I,s.J,s.P,s.SG,s.SX,s.SY=map(np.array,(I,J,P,SG,SX,SY))\n        s.tri=s.P>=0; s.ext=s.P<=-2; s.ne=2*W*H\n    def pf_terms(s,w):\n        \"\"\"w: weights per lattice edge (tanh). Return list of 4 matrices\"\"\"\n        val=np.ones(len(s.P)); val[s.tri]=w[s.P[s.tri]]\n        out=[]\n        for ex,ey in itertools.product((0,1),(0,1)):\n            sg=s.SG*np.where((s.SX&ex)|(s.SY&ey),-1.,1.)\n            A=np.zeros((s.n,s.n)); A[s.I,s.J]=sg*val; A[s.J,s.I]=-sg*val\n            out.append((A,sg))\n        return out\ndef pfaffian_schur(A):\n    T,Z=sl.schur(A,output='real'); n=len(A)\n    b=T[np.arange(0,n,2),np.arange(1,n,2)]\n    sgn,ld=np.linalg.slogdet(Z)\n    return sgn*np.prod(np.sign(b)), np.sum(np.log(np.abs(b)))\nEOF\ncat > /root/work/test.py <<'EOF'\nimport sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/root/work')\nfrom ising import *\nW,H=4,3\nrng=np.random.default_rng(0)\nfor par in [lambda L:(L-1)%2, lambda L:1, lambda L:0, lambda L:L%2]:\n  try: m=Model(W,H,par)\n  except AssertionError as e: print('inc');continue\n  K=rng.uniform(-0.35,0.9,2*W*H); w=np.tanh(K)\n  # brute S = sum over even subgraphs prod t\n  N=W*H; S=0\n  for c in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=2*N):\n    deg=np.zeros(N,int)\n    for e,u in enumerate(c):\n      if u:\n        v=e//2; x,y=v%W,v//W; u2=((x+1)%W+W*y) if e%2==0 else (x+W*((y+1)%H))\n        deg[v]+=1;deg[u2]+=1\n    if np.all(deg%2==0): S+=np.prod(w[np.array(c)==1])\n  pf=[ (lambda r:r[0]*np.exp(r[1]))(pfaffian_schur(A)) for A,_ in m.pf_terms(w)]\n  print(S,pf)\nEOF\npython /root/work/test.py\" failed with exit code 144","uuid":"9e23e893-ca50-4152-bbe1-398e412e9c1c","session_id":"08b490ed-295a-48e1-96f2-31d974f30297"}

J=m.J[s.tri_idx]\n                cols=np.unique(I)\n                rhs=np.zeros((m.n,len(cols))); rhs[cols,np.arange(len(cols))]=1\n                X=sl.lu_solve(lu,rhs,check_finite=False)  # X[:,c]=Ainv[:,cols[c]]\n                pos=np.searchsorted(cols,I)\n                contrib=sg[s.tri_idx]*X[J,pos]   # Ainv[j,i]\n                g=np.bincount(m.P[s.tri_idx],weights=contrib,minlength=len(w))\n            out.append((sgn,L,g))\n        return out\n    def find_c(s):\n        # rings test\n        W,H=s.W,s.H; ne=2*W*H\n        rows=[];rhs=[]\n        for hr,vr in [(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)]:\n            w=np.zeros(ne); a=0.7;b=0.6\n            if hr: w[[2*(x+W*0) for x in range(W)]]=a\n            if vr: w[[2*(0+W*y)+1 for y in range(H)]]=b\n            S=1+(a**W if hr else 0)+(b**H if vr else 0)+((a**W*b**H) if hr and vr else 0)\n            r=s.pf_all(w,None,False,exact=True)\n            rows.append([sg*np.exp(L) for sg,L,_ in r]); rhs.append(S)\n        c=np.linalg.solve(np.array(rows),np.array(rhs)); print('c',c); return np.round(c*2)/2\n    def logZ(s,K,h,grad=True,exact=False):\n        w=np.tanh(K); tau=np.tanh(h); ne=len(w)\n        terms=[]  # (sign, log, gradlog wrt w (vector), dict tau-derivs)\n        r=s.pf_all(w,'0',grad,exact)\n        for k,(sg,L,g) in enumerate(r):\n            if s.c[k]!=0: terms.append((sg*np.sign(s.c[k]),L+np.log(abs(s.c[k])),g,None))\n        for pi,(a,b,E) in enumerate(s.pairs):\n            w2=w.copy(); w2[E]=1/w[E]\n            pre=tau[a]*tau[b]*np.prod(w[E])\n            r=s.pf_all(w2,str(pi),grad,exact)\n            for k,(sg,L,g) in enumerate(r):\n                if s.c[k]==0: continue\n                gl=None\n                if grad:\n                    gl=g.copy(); gl[E]=1/w[E]-g[E]/w[E]**2\n                terms.append((sg*np.sign(s.c[k])*np.sign(pre),L+np.log(abs(s.c[k]))+np.log(abs(pre)),gl,(a,b)))\n        Lmax=max(t[1] for t in terms)\n        vals=np.array([t[0]*np.exp(t[1]-Lmax) for t in terms]); F=vals.sum()\n        assert F>0, F\n        lz=np.sum(np.log(np.cosh(K)))+np.sum(np.log(np.cosh(h)))+Lmax+np.log(F)\n        if not grad: return lz\n        dFw=sum(v*t[2] for v,t in zip(vals,terms))\n        dFt=np.zeros(len(h))\n        for v,t in zip(vals,terms):\n            if t[3]: a,b=t[3]; dFt[a]+=v/tau[a]; dFt[b]+=v/tau[b]\n        gK=w+dFw*(1-w**2)/F; gh=tau+dFt*(1-tau**2)/F\n        return lz,gK,gh\nEOF\ncat > test3.py <<'EOF'\nfrom solver import *\nW,H=4,5; sites=[(0,0),(2,3),(3,1)]\nrng=np.random.default_rng(3); Z=p.sum(); p/=Z\nmK=np.array([ (p*sp[:,y,x]*(sp[:,y,(x+1)%W] if d==0 else sp[:,(y+1)%H,x])).sum() for y in range(H) for x in range(W) for d in (0,1)])\nmh=np.array([(p*sp[:,y,x]).sum() for x,y in sites])\nprint(lz,np.log(Z));
